welcome.title: Welcome to Hat
welcome.body: An AI assistant that lives in your menu bar. One shortcut and you're chatting with top-tier models — no browser tab, no setup.

shortcuts.title: Three shortcuts for everything
shortcuts.lede: Each feature has a global shortcut. Works in any app.
shortcuts.row2Desc: Copy text, press the shortcut, the AI answers

modes.title: Pick the right brain
modes.lede: Three AI modes balancing speed, cost, and capability.
modes.foot: Each mode uses a different amount of credits.

credits.title: How credits work
credits.bullet1: Every message uses credits — the more powerful the mode, the more it costs.
credits.bullet2: You top up via PIX directly with Hat's creator, in seconds.
credits.bullet3: Your balance stays synced in the cloud — open it on any machine.

signin.ledeGuest: Sign in with Google to get your balance, chat history, and top-tier models — all synced.
signin.ledeSigned: Signed in as {{name}}. Your credits are already synced.

done.title: All set!
done.body: Call Hat any time with <kbd>{{hotkey}}</kbd>. To top up credits, go to Settings → Account.
